title: Identifying the class and its members
shortTitle: Identifying the class and its members
summary: Class identification concerns whether the group is defined so that membership can be determined and the action fairly administered. The readings report disagreement about adding a separate administrative-feasibility requirement.
notes: The Ninth Circuit’s approach differs from the Third Circuit approach discussed in the opinion.

sections.Meaning: Class identification concerns whether the group is defined so that membership can be determined and the action fairly administered. The readings report disagreement about adding a separate administrative-feasibility requirement.
sections.How to work through the question: State objective membership criteria and consider available proof, notice, claims administration, and the defendant’s ability to contest membership. Briseno places feasibility concerns within the express Rule 23 framework rather than adding an independent bar.
